asked: # Build: console-claude-auth Brett's request (voice, verbatim): "I need console to have settings to set authorization tokens for Claude subscription with refresh token and fallback to API where I can enter it." ## Read first CLAUDE.md (and its imports), `_claude/shared/rules/RULES.md`, `_claude/THREADS.md`, STATUS.md. Then find what already exists: the console's account picker ("one active Claude subscription account" work, PR #105), `deploy/claude-pick.sh`, `deploy/claude-headless.sh`, the console Settings interface asset and the systems-check settings that already store `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Build on those; do not make a parallel system. ## What to build A **Claude authorization** section in Dev Console Settings: 1. **Subscription (primary):** fields for the Claude subscription OAuth access token and refresh token (plus expiry, if known). Auto-refresh the access token with the refresh token before it expires, and save rotated tokens back. Show status: which credential is active, expiry, last refresh, last error. Use only the officially supported Claude Code / Anthropic mechanisms (e.g. `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `claude setup-token`, the documented refresh flow). Do not invent endpoints; if no supported refresh flow exists, implement the closest supported option and say so clearly in the report. 2. **API key (fallback):** a field where Brett enters an Anthropic API key. A switch to enable fallback. When the subscription credential is missing, expired and unrefreshable, rejected, or out of usage, fall back to the API key automatically, and switch back once the subscription works again. Log every switch. 3. **Test** button per credential (cheap call, reports OK/fail, never prints the secret). 4. Everything that runs Claude uses this: the console assistant, `claude-pick.sh`, `claude-headless.sh` / headless builds started by axHub `vps.build_start`. ## Rules - Secrets are write-only in the UI: masked (last 4 chars at most), never logged, never echoed, never in build logs, reports, commits or THREADS.md. Never `cat` or print `/opt/axf/.axf-console/secrets.env`. Store secrets the same way the console already stores credentials, with 600 perms. - UI is framework controls + hot-swappable assets, reusing the existing Settings interface asset and existing settings schema. No new asset type (if you find one is truly needed, stop and say so in the report instead). - Models: Opus or Fable only, never Sonnet or Haiku, anywhere you touch model config. - Phone-friendly layout; add help@1 text for the new section. - Tests: unit tests for the fallback/refresh decision logic (mock the network) and a test that no secret value reaches logs. Typecheck, build and the framework validator must pass. - Branch `claude/console-claude-auth`, open a PR, do not merge. Add a THREADS.md row with a "To carry on" block, and a report at `_claude/builds/reports/console-claude-auth.md` (what was built, refresh mechanism used, how to set it up from the phone, open questions). Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
